summary.text: PLA-CF is carbon-fibre-filled PLA. Makers sell it for functional parts, design projects and everyday prototyping, and describe a matt surface with a carbon-fibre look. On the H2C every product needs a hardened nozzle, but it prints at 200⁠–⁠230 °C with no heated chamber.
